questions.prompt: The consul spoke in the forum, and the crowd listened eagerly.
questions.answer: Cōnsul in forō dīxit, et turba avidē audīvit.

questions.prompt: The enemy attacked the walls, but the citizens bravely defended the city.
questions.answer: Hostēs mūrōs oppugnāvērunt, sed cīvēs urbem fortiter dēfendērunt.

questions.prompt: The poet writes verses and sings sweet songs.
questions.answer: Poēta versūs scrībit et dulcia carmina canit.

questions.prompt: The general praised the soldiers who had captured the camp.
questions.answer: Dux mīlitēs laudāvit quī castra cēperant.

questions.prompt: I admire the woman whose courage the whole city praises.
questions.answer: Fēminam admīror cuius virtūtem tōta urbs laudat.

questions.prompt: The old man told stories which the children gladly heard.
questions.answer: Senex fābulās nārrābat quās līberī libenter audiēbant.

questions.prompt: We drank the wine that the host had brought from Greece.
questions.answer: Vīnum bibimus quod hospes ex Graeciā attulerat.

questions.prompt: When the sun had set, the shepherds drove the flocks home.
questions.answer: Cum sōl occidisset, pāstōrēs gregēs domum ēgērunt.

questions.prompt: Because the road was long, the travelers rested in the shade.
questions.answer: Quod via longa erat, viātōrēs in umbrā requiēvērunt.

questions.prompt: While the mother wept, the father consoled the frightened children.
questions.answer: Dum māter flēbat, pater territōs līberōs cōnsōlābātur.

questions.prompt: Having seen the fire, the neighbors ran quickly to the house.
questions.answer: Ignem cōnspicātī vīcīnī celeriter ad domum cucurrērunt.

questions.prompt: The king was proud, but his words seemed insulting to the senators.
questions.answer: Rēx superbus erat, sed verba eius patribus contumēliōsa vidēbantur.

questions.prompt: The messenger announced the victory and the whole state rejoiced.
questions.answer: Nūntius victōriam nūntiāvit et tōta cīvitās gāvīsa est.

questions.prompt: The frightened horse fled, and the rider fell onto the ground.
questions.answer: Territus equus fūgit, et eques in terram cecidit.

questions.prompt: The teacher orders the students to read the poems that Vergil wrote.
questions.answer: Magister discipulōs iubet carmina legere quae Vergilius scrīpsit.

questions.prompt: The maidens fled into the woods, where they hid for a long time.
questions.answer: Virginēs in silvās fūgērunt, ubi diū latuērunt.

questions.prompt: Though the wound was grave, the soldier did not abandon his post.
questions.answer: Quamquam vulnus grave erat, mīles locum nōn relīquit.

questions.prompt: The philosopher taught the young men who eagerly sought wisdom.
questions.answer: Philosophus iuvenēs docēbat quī sapientiam avidē petēbant.

questions.prompt: The queen was sitting on her throne, and the courtiers praised her beauty.
questions.answer: Rēgīna in soliō sedēbat, et aulicī pulchritūdinem eius laudābant.

questions.prompt: The pale soldier feared nothing, for his conscience was untroubled.
questions.answer: Mīles pallidus nihil timēbat, nam cōnscientia eius inconcussa erat.

questions.prompt: The Cyclops seized the sailors whom he had found in the cave.
questions.answer: Cyclōps nautās rapuit quōs in spēluncā invēnerat.

questions.prompt: The maiden whom the poet loved was elegant and modest.
questions.answer: Virgō quam poēta amābat elegāns et modesta erat.

questions.prompt: The king emptied the treasury, and the citizens deserted the walls.
questions.answer: Rēx aerārium exinānīvit, et cīvēs moenia dēseruērunt.

questions.prompt: The marriage which the father had approved brought lasting joy.
questions.answer: Cōnūbium quod pater probāverat gaudium perpetuum attulit.

questions.prompt: The experienced leader flattered the soldiers, but he trusted no one.
questions.answer: Dux expertus mīlitibus blandiēbātur, sed nēminī cōnfīdēbat.

questions.prompt: The boy threw away the sword which his grandfather had carried into battle.
questions.answer: Puer gladium abiēcit quem avus in proelium tulerat.

questions.prompt: I ask it of you, protect me.
questions.answer: ā tē petō, mē dēfendās.

questions.prompt: Prayers and tears had weight.
questions.answer: valēbant precēs et lacrimae.

questions.prompt: It came to pass the same night that there was a full moon.
questions.answer: eādem nocte accidit ut esset lūna plēna.

questions.prompt: The estate which is in the territory which is called Sabine, that I maintain is mine.
questions.answer: fundus quī est in agrō, quī Sabīnus vocātur, eum meum esse aiō.
